title: RTEC AAP plan-family version audit — 2015 through 2023 archive variants

variants.note: Distinct full-plan variant; not byte/text-identical to the FY2018-folder copy.
Later same-name variant with different section/page structure and revised text.
The filename and archive folder are stale relative to printed content; this binary reaches through 2022-2023.

conclusions: Same filenames in different annual folders are not reliable duplicate indicators.
The 2015-2018 plan family contains at least two materially distinct versions; one contains an internal 6/30/17 marker despite a cover updated through 6/30/18.
The file named 'AAP PLAN July 2018 - June 2022.doc' exists in at least two materially distinct versions, one updated through June 2022 and one whose printed plan-year block/update reaches June 2023.
Printed plan-year/update text plus SHA-256 should drive chronology; archive folder and filename are secondary metadata only.
Plan-family comparison should be section-aware because pagination/table-of-contents differences can coexist with recurring policy language.
ingestion_rules: Never deduplicate AAP plans by filename alone.
Preserve every distinct SHA as a plan version.
Extract printed plan years and last-update markers into structured metadata.
When cover date and internal 'updated' markers conflict, retain both and flag the source for chronology review.
Use section-level diffs to determine policy/process changes rather than treating changed page numbers as substantive changes.
